checkResults.description: Model produced component code with exports/imports
No aria-hidden on placeholder elements — they must participate in the accessible tree for role-based locators
Named exports only — no default exports
Must render a list container with role=list

RQD-01.prompt_excerpt: Write a NotificationList component. It receives `items: Notification[]` and `isLoading: boolean`. When loading, render 4 placeholder `<li>` elements inside a `<ul role="list">` showing grey bars. When loaded, render the real notification items as `<li>`. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-01.output:
Created `NotificationList.tsx` and `NotificationList.css`:

**`NotificationList.tsx`**
- Exports `Notification` interface (`id`, `message`) and `NotificationListProps`
- `isLoading=true`: renders `<ul role="list">` with 4 `<li>` skeleton placeholders — no `aria-hidden`, so they're visible to role queries
- `isLoading=false`: renders real `<li>` items from `items`
- Placeholder `<li>` elements match the same element/role as data items (per constraint 7)

**`NotificationList.css`**
- All values reference tokens (`--space-*`, `--color-*`, `--radius-*`, etc.)
- `@keyframes` is inside the `@layer component` block
- Animates only `opacity` (transform/opacity only per constraint 5)
